_about: Public-domain Thomas Armitage (1819-1896), Baptist minister of the Fifth Avenue Baptist Church, New York, for the Word Hoard: the funeral sermon on Spencer Houghton Cone (1855), The Past, Present and Future of the United States (1862) and A History of the Baptists (1887), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 53 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

armitage-cone-funeral: The funeral sermon on the death of Rev. Spencer Houghton Cone, D.D., late pastor of the First Baptist church, New York (New York, Holman & Gray, printers, 1855)
armitage-past-present-future: The past, present and future of the United States: a discourse (New York : Printed and published by T. Holman, 1862)
armitage-history-of-baptists: A history of the Baptists : traced by their vital principles and practices : from the time of Our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ to the year 1886 (New York : Bryan, Taylor, 1887)

_alternates.armitage-copies: The two-volume issue of the History (historyofbaptist01armi, 02armi) and the 1893 printing

_excluded.armitage-other: The Education and Employment of the Blind (1886, by Thomas Rhodes Armitage, another man)
